articles.title: Gaza civil defence says Israeli fire kills four
articles.description: Gaza's civil defence told AFP that Israeli fire killed four people on Saturday, including three in a strike on a vehicle carrying food aid in the war-ravaged territory. Israel and Hamas regularly accuse each other of violating the ceasefire that came into effect in October 2025, after two years of war triggered by the Palestinian Islamist movement's unprecedented attack on Israel on October 7, 2023.
